ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِؕ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْخَبِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi walahul-hamdu fil-aakhirati wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
ayahs.translationClear: Praise be to Allah, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and praise be to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Wise, the Expert.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيْهَاؕ وَهُوَ الرَّحِيْمُ الْغَفُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa wahuwar-raheemul-ghafoor
ayahs.translationClear: He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky, and what ascends to it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ‌ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ‌ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَا تَاْتِيْنَا السَّاعَةُؕ قُلْ بَلٰي وَرَبِّيْ لَتَاْتِيَنَّكُمْۙ عٰلِمِ الْغَيْبِۚ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا͏ٓ اَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا͏ٓ اَكْبَرُ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ࣗۙ

words.translation: surely it will come to you

ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allāh is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight[1218] within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'teenas-saa'atu qul balaa warabbee lata'tiyannakum 'aalimil-ghaybi laa ya'zubu 'anhu mithqaalu dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi walaa asgharu min dhaalika walaa akbaru illaa fee kitaabim mubeen

footnotes.1218: Or "the weight of a small ant."

ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve say, “The Hour will not come upon us.” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, it will come upon you. He is the Knower of the unseen.” Not an atom’s weight in the heavens and the earth, or anything smaller or larger, escapes His knowledge. All are in a Clear Record.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ‌ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّرِزْقٌ كَرِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareem
ayahs.translationClear: That He may recompense those who believe and do good works. Those will have forgiveness, and a generous provision.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ سَعَوْ فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيْنَ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّنْ رِّجْزٍ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure[1219] - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum mir rijzin aleem

footnotes.1219: i.e., to undermine their credibility in order to defeat the Prophet (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: As for those who strive against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—for them is a punishment of a painful plague.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَرَي الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ الَّذِيْٓ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ هُوَ الْحَقَّۙ وَيَهْدِيْٓ اِلٰي صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَمِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaral-ladheena ootul-'ilmal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbika huwal-haqqa wayahdee ilaa siraatil-'azeezil-hameed
ayahs.translationClear: Those who received knowledge know that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth; and it guides to the path of the Majestic, the Praiseworthy.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ يُّنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ اِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍۙ اِنَّكُمْ لَفِيْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo hal nadullukum 'alaa rajulin yunabbi'ukum idhaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieved said, “Shall we point out to you a man, who will tell you that, once torn into shreds, you will be in a new creation?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَـٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ‌ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَـٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفْتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا اَمْ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌؕ بَلِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ فِي الْعَذَابِ وَالضَّلٰلِ الْبَعِيْدِ
ayahs.translation: Has he invented about Allāh a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.
ayahs.transliteration: Aftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban am bihee jinnatum balil-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati fil-'adhaabi wad-dalaalil-ba'eed
ayahs.translationClear: Did he invent a lie about Allah, or is there madness in him?” Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in torment, and far astray.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلٰي مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ اِنْ نَّشَاْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ الْاَرْضَ اَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيْبٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Afalam yaraw ilaa maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi in nasha' nakhsif bihimul-arda aw nusqit 'alayhim kisafam minas-samaa'i inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal likulli 'abdim muneeb
ayahs.translationClear: Do they not reflect upon what lies before them and behind them, of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth cave in beneath them, or make pieces of the sky fall down on them. In that is a sign for every devout servant.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَـٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا‌ۖ يَـٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ‌ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا دَاوٗدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًاؕ يٰجِبَالُ اَوِّبِيْ مَعَهٗ وَالطَّيْرَۚ وَاَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيْدَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa daawooda minnaa fadlan yaajibaalu awwibee ma'ahoo wat-tayra wa'alannaa lahul-hadeed
ayahs.translationClear: We bestowed upon David favor from Us: “O mountains, and birds: echo with him.” And We softened iron for him.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ‌ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا‌ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنِ اعْمَلْ سٰبِغٰتٍ وَّقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ وَاعْمَلُوْا صَالِحًاؕ اِنِّيْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."
ayahs.transliteration: Ani'mal saabighaatin waqaddir fis-sardi wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona baseer
ayahs.translationClear: “Make coats of armor, and measure the links well; and work righteousness. I am Observant of everything you do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ‌ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ‌ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ‌ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِسُلَيْمٰنَ الرِّيْحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَّرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌۚ وَاَسَلْنَا لَهٗ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِؕ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَنْ يَّعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَمَنْ يَّزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ اَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.translation: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Walisulaymaanar-reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahrun warawaahuhaa shahrun wa'asalnaa lahoo 'aynal-qitri waminal-jinni man ya'malu bayna yadayhi bi'idhni rabbihee waman yazigh minhum 'an amrinaa nudhiqhu min 'adhaabis-sa'eer
ayahs.translationClear: And for Solomon the wind—its outward journey was one month, and its return journey was one month. And We made a spring of tar flow for him. And there were sprites that worked under him, by the leave of his Lord. But whoever of them swerved from Our command, We make him taste of the punishment of the Inferno.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَـٰرِيبَ وَتَمَـٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَـٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَـٰرِيبَ وَتَمَـٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَـٰتٍ‌ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا‌ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَعْمَلُوْنَ لَهٗ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ مَّحَارِيْبَ وَتَمَاثِيْلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُوْرٍ رّٰسِيٰتٍؕ اِعْمَلُوْٓا اٰلَ دَاوٗدَ شُكْرًاؕ وَقَلِيْلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers,[1220] statues,[1221] bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'maloona lahoo maa yashaa'u mim mahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaanin kal-jawaabi waqudoorir raasiyaatini'maloo aala daawooda shukran waqaleelum min 'ibaadiyash-shakoor

footnotes.1220: Described by commentators as palaces, dwellings, or places of prayer.
footnotes.1221: Which were not prohibited until the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: They made for him whatever he wished: sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons. “O House of David, work with appreciation,” but a few of My servants are appreciative.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ‌ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلٰي مَوْتِهٖٓ اِلَّا دَا࢜بَّةُ الْاَرْضِ تَاْكُلُ مِنْسَاَتَهٗۚ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الْجِنُّ اَنْ لَّوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ الْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوْا فِي الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِيْنِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff.[1222] But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.[1223]
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa qadaynaa 'alayhil-mawta maa dallahum 'alaa mawtihee illaa daabbatul-ardi ta'kulu minsa'atahoo falammaa kharra tabayyanatil-jinnu al law kaanoo ya'lamoonal-ghayba maa labithoo fil-'adhaabil-muheen

footnotes.1222: Upon which he was leaning at the time of his death. A termite continued to gnaw into the stick until it collapsed under his weight.
footnotes.1223: i.e., hard labor. This verse is evidence that the jinn do not possess knowledge of the unseen, which belongs exclusively to Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

ayahs.translationClear: Then, when We decreed death for him, nothing indicated his death to them except an earthworm eating at his staff. Then, when he fell down, it became clear to the sprites that, had they known the unseen, they would not have remained in the demeaning torment.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ‌ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ‌ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ‌ۚ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَاٍ فِيْ مَسْكَنِهِمْ اٰيَةٌۚ جَنَّتٰنِ عَنْ يَّمِيْنٍ وَّشِمَالٍ࣢ؕ كُلُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوْا لَهٗؕ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَّرَبٌّ غَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: There was for [the tribe of] Saba’ in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad kaana lisaba'in fee maskanihim aayatun jannataani 'an yameenin washimaalin kuloo mir rizqi rabbikum washkuroo lahoo baldatun tayyibatun warabbun ghafoor
ayahs.translationClear: In Sheba’s homeland there used to be a wonder: two gardens, on the right, and on the left. “Eat of your Lord’s provision, and give thanks to Him.” A good land, and a forgiving Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَعْرَضُوْا فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنٰهُمْ بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَيْ اُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَّاَثْلٍ وَّشَيْءٍ مِّنْ سِدْرٍ قَلِيْلٍ
ayahs.translation: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam,[1224] and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'a'radoo fa'arsalnaa 'alayhim saylal-'arimi wabaddalnaahum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawaatay ukulin khamtin wa'athlin washay'im min sidrin qaleel

footnotes.1224: i.e., caused by a break in their dam. Another meaning is "the overwhelming flood."

ayahs.translationClear: But they turned away, so We unleashed against them the flood of the dam; and We substituted their two gardens with two gardens of bitter fruits, thorny shrubs, and meager harvest.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَـٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟‌ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَـٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ جَزَيْنٰهُمْ بِمَا كَفَرُوْاؕ وَهَلْ نُجٰزِيْٓ اِلَّا الْكَفُوْرَ
ayahs.translation: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaroo wahal nujaazee illal-kafoor
ayahs.translationClear: We thus penalized them for their ingratitude. Would We penalize any but the ungrateful?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَـٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَـٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ‌ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَي الَّتِيْ بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَا قُرًي ظَاهِرَةً وَّقَدَّرْنَا فِيْهَا السَّيْرَؕ سِيْرُوْا فِيْهَا لَيَالِيَ وَاَيَّامًا اٰمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed[1225] [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey,[1226] [saying], "Travel between them by night or by day in safety."
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnaa baynahum wabaynal-qural-latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahiratan waqaddarnaa feehas-sayra seeroo feehaa layaaliya wa'ayyaaman aamineen

footnotes.1225: In the lands of what is now southern Syria and Palestine.
footnotes.1226: i.e., We placed the intermediate settlements at calculated distances for the convenience of travelers.

ayahs.translationClear: Between them and the towns We had blessed, We placed prominent towns, and We made the travel between them easy. “Travel between them by night and day, in safety.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَـٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَـٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَـٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَـٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا بٰعِدْ بَيْنَ اَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَحَادِيْثَ وَمَزَّقْنٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوْرٍ
ayahs.translation: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations[1227] and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaaloo rabbanaa baa'id bayna asfaarinaa wazalamoo anfusahum faja'alnaahum ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor

footnotes.1227: Stories related to others as lessons or examples.

ayahs.translationClear: But they said, “Our Lord, lengthen the distances of our journeys.” They wronged themselves; so We made them history, and We scattered them in every direction. In this are lessons for every steadfast and appreciative person.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ اِبْلِيْسُ ظَنَّهٗ فَاتَّبَعُوْهُ اِلَّا فَرِيْقًا مِّنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Iblees had already confirmed through them[1228] his assumption,[1229] so they followed him, except for a party of believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad saddaqa 'alayhim ibleesu zannahoo fattaba'oohu illaa fareeqam minal-mu'mineen

footnotes.1228: i.e., the people of Saba’ or mankind in general.
footnotes.1229: That mankind could readily be misled by him.

ayahs.translationClear: Satan was correct in his assessment of them. They followed him, except for a group of believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ‌ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ سُلْطٰنٍ اِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِيْ شَكٍّؕ وَرَبُّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيْظٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.[1230]
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa kaana lahoo 'alayhim min sultaanin illaa lina'lama man yu'minu bil-aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakkin warabbuka 'alaa kulli shay'in hafeez

footnotes.1230: Protecting and preserving the existence and attributes of His creations.

ayahs.translationClear: He had no authority over them; except that We willed to distinguish him who believes in the Hereafter, from him who is doubtful about it. Your Lord is Guardian over all things.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِيْنَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِۚ لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيْهِمَا مِنْ شِرْكٍ وَّمَا لَهٗ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ ظَهِيْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allāh." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.
ayahs.transliteration: Qulid'ul-ladheena za'amtum min doonillaahi laa yamlikoona mithqaala dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirkin wamaa lahoo minhum min zaheer
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Call upon those whom you claim besides Allah. They possess not an atom’s weight in the heavens or the earth, and they possess no share of either, and He has no backers from among them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ‌ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ‌ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهٗٓ اِلَّا لِمَنْ اَذِنَ لَهٗؕ حَتّٰٓي اِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ قَالُوْا مَاذَاۙ قَالَ رَبُّكُمْؕ قَالُوا الْحَقَّۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts,[1231] they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu 'indahoo illaa liman adhina lahoo hattaa idhaa fuzzi'a 'an quloobihim qaaloo maadhaa qaala rabbukum qaalul-haqqa wahuwal-'aliyyul-kabeer

footnotes.1231: i.e., the hearts of the angels who will be permitted to intercede.

ayahs.translationClear: Intercession with Him is of no value, except for someone He has permitted. Until, when fear has subsided from their hearts, they will say, “What did your Lord say?” They will say, “The truth, and He is the High, the Great.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ‌ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَنْ يَّرْزُقُكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ قُلِ اللّٰهُۙ وَاِنَّا͏ٓ اَوْ اِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلٰي هُدًي اَوْ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul man yarzuqukum minas-samaawaati wal-ardi qulillaahu wa'innaa aw iyyaakum la'alaa hudan aw fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah. And either you, or we, are rightly guided, or in evident error.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لَّا تُسْـٔ͏َلُوْنَ عَمَّا͏ٓ اَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـٔ͏َلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul laa tus'aloona 'ammaa ajramnaa walaa nus'alu 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “You will not be asked about our misdeeds, nor will we be asked about what you do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّؕ وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."[1232]
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bil-haqqi wahuwal-fattaahul-'aleem

footnotes.1232: Literally, "Opener," i.e., He who decides and lays open all matters in truth and justice and who opens the way to victory, success, relief, knowledge and understanding.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us equitably. He is the All-Knowing Judge.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ‌ۖ كَلَّا‌ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اَرُوْنِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَلْحَقْتُمْ بِهٖ شُرَكَا࢜ءَ كَلَّاؕ بَلْ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul arooniyal-ladheena alhaqtum bihee shurakaa'a kallaa bal huwallaahul-'azeezul-hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Show me those you have attached to Him as associates. No indeed! But He is Allah, the Powerful, the Wise.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا كَا࢜فَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيْرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have not sent you except comprehensively[1233] to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatal linnaasi basheeran wanadheeran walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: We sent you only universally to all people, a herald and warner, but most people do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When is this promise due, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ لَّكُمْ مِّيْعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَّلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul lakum mee'aadu yawmil laa tasta'khiroona 'anhu saa'atan walaa tastaqdimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “You are promised a Day, which you cannot postpone by one hour, nor bring forward.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ‌ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَنْ نُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنَ بِهٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِؕ وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذِ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ مَوْقُوْفُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْۚۖ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ اِلٰي بَعْضِ اࣙلْقَوْلَۚ يَقُوْلُ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا لَوْلَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words...[1234] Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaadhal-qur'aani walaa bil-ladhee bayna yadayhi walaw taraa idhiz-zaalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'dinil-qawla yaqoolul-ladheenastud'ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo lawlaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen

footnotes.1234: Having been left to the imagination, the conclusion of this sentence is estimated to be "...you would see a dreadful sight."

ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve say, “We will never believe in this Quran, nor in what came before it.” If you could only see the wrongdoers, captive before their Lord, throwing back allegations at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “Were it not for you, we would have been believers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم‌ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْٓا اَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنٰكُمْ عَنِ الْهُدٰي بَعْدَ اِذْ جَا࢜ءَكُمْ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ مُّجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo lilladheenastud'ifoo anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil-hudaa ba'da idh jaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen
ayahs.translationClear: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, “Was it us who turned you away from guidance when it came to you? No indeed, you yourselves were sinful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا‌ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟‌ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا بَلْ مَكْرُ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ اِذْ تَاْمُرُوْنَنَا͏ٓ اَنْ نَّكْفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهٗٓ اَنْدَادًاؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الْعَذَابَؕ وَجَعَلْنَا الْاَغْلٰلَ فِيْٓ اَعْنَاقِ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاؕ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheenastud'ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo bal makrul-layli wan-nahaari idh ta'muroonanaa an nakfura billaahi wanaj'ala lahoo andaadan wa'asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'awul-'adhaaba waja'alnal-aghlaala fee a'naaqil-ladheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: And those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, “It was your scheming by night and day; as you instructed us to reject Allah, and to set up rivals to Him.” They will hide their remorse when they see the retribution. We will put yokes around the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be repaid for anything other than what they used to do?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا فِيْ قَرْيَةٍ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوْهَا͏ٓۙ اِنَّا بِمَا͏ٓ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa fee qaryatim min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: We sent no warner to any town, without its affluent saying, “We reject what you are sent with.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا نَحْنُ اَكْثَرُ اَمْوَالًا وَّاَوْلَادًاۙ وَّمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they[1235] said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo nahnu aktharu amwaalan wa'awlaadan wamaa nahnu bimu'adhdhabeen

footnotes.1235: The affluent ones in general or the people of Makkah specifically.

ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “We have more wealth and more children, and we will not be punished.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wayaqdiru walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “My Lord spreads out His bounty to whomever He wills, or restricts it; but most people do not know.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا͏ٓ اَوْلَادُكُمْ بِالَّتِيْ تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِنْدَنَا زُلْفٰٓي اِلَّا مَنْ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًاؗ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ جَزَا࢜ءُ الضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوْا وَهُمْ فِي الْغُرُفٰتِ اٰمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa amwaalukum walaa awlaadukum bil-latee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zulfaa illaa man aamana wa'amila saalihan fa'ulaa'ika lahum jazaa'ud-di'fi bimaa 'amiloo wahum fil-ghurufaati aaminoon
ayahs.translationClear: It is neither your wealth nor your children that bring you closer to Us, but it is he who believes and does good deeds. These will have a double reward for what they did; and they will reside in the Chambers, in peace and security.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَا مُعٰجِزِيْنَ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure[1236] - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yas'awna fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika fil-'adhaabi muhdaroon
ayahs.translationClear: But those who work against Our revelations, seeking to undermine them—those will be summoned to the punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ‌ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ‌ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهٗؕ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْفَقْتُمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهٗۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرّٰزِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee wayaqdiru lahoo wamaa anfaqtum min shay'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo wahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “My Lord extends the provision to whomever He wills of His servants, or withholds it. Anything you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of providers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيْعًا ثُمَّ يَقُوْلُ لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اَهٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوْا يَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'an thumma yaqoolu lilmalaa'ikati ahaa'ulaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when He gathers them all together, then say to the angels, “Was it you these used to worship?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم‌ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ‌ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ اَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْۚ بَلْ كَانُوْا يَعْبُدُوْنَ الْجِنَّۚ اَكْثَرُهُمْ بِهِمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo subhaanaka anta waliyyunaa min doonihim bal kaanoo ya'budoonal-jinna aktharuhum bihim mu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: They will say, “Be You glorified; You are our Master, not them. In fact, they used to worship the jinn, and most of them had faith in them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَّلَا ضَرًّاؕ وَنَقُوْلُ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: Fal-yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'an walaa darran wanaqoolu lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo 'adhaaban-naaril-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
ayahs.translationClear: “Today, none of you has the power to profit or harm the other.” And We will say to those who did wrong, “Taste the agony of the Fire which you used to deny.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى‌ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا تُتْلٰي عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالُوْا مَا هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يَّصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ اٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْۚ وَقَالُوْا مَا هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا͏ٓ اِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًيؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَا࢜ءَهُمْۙ اِنْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaa'ukum waqaaloo maa haadhaa illaa ifkum muftaran waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaa'ahum in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And when Our enlightening Verses are recited to them, they say, “This is nothing but a man who wants to divert you from what your ancestors used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a fabricated lie.” And when the truth comes to them, the blasphemers say of the truth, “This is nothing but plain magic.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا‌ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ كُتُبٍ يَّدْرُسُوْنَهَا وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِنْ نَّذِيْرٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa aataynaahum min kutubin yadrusoonahaa wamaa arsalnaa ilayhim qablaka min nadheer
ayahs.translationClear: But We gave them no book to study, and We did not send them any warner before you.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى‌ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْۙ وَمَا بَلَغُوْا مِعْشَارَ مَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوْا رُسُلِيْࣞ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيْرِ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim wamaa balaghoo mi'shaara maa aataynaahum fakadhdhaboo rusulee fakayfa kaana nakeer
ayahs.translationClear: Those before them also denied the truth, yet they have not attained one-tenth of what We had given them. They rejected My messengers, so how was My disapproval?

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ‌ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟‌ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ‌ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَعِظُكُمْ بِوَاحِدَةٍۚ اَنْ تَقُوْمُوْا لِلّٰهِ مَثْنٰي وَفُرَادٰي ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوْاࣞ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمْ مِّنْ جِنَّةٍؕ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا نَذِيْرٌ لَّكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamaa a'izukum biwaahidatin an taqoomoo lillaahi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaroo maa bisaahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illaa nadheerul lakum bayna yaday 'adhaabin shadeed
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I offer you a single advice: devote yourselves to Allah, in pairs, or individually; and reflect. There is no madness in your friend. He is just a warner to you, before the advent of a severe punishment.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ‌ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَا سَاَلْتُكُمْ مِّنْ اَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْؕ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul maa sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illaa 'alallaahi wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Whatever compensation I have asked of you, is yours. My compensation comes only from Allah, and He is Witness over all things.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ يَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّۚ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yaqdhifu bil-haqqi 'allaamul-ghuyoob
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “My Lord projects the truth. He is the Knower of the unseen.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ جَا࢜ءَ الْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِي͏ٔ͏ُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيْدُ
ayahs.translation: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."[1237]
ayahs.transliteration: Qul jaa'al-haqqu wamaa yubdi'ul-baatilu wamaa yu'eed

footnotes.1237: This expression alludes to complete inability, meaning that falsehood was abolished.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “The truth has come; while falsehood can neither originate, nor regenerate.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى‌ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنْ ضَلَلْتُ فَاِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَضِلُّ عَلٰي نَفْسِيْۚ وَاِنِ اهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوْحِيْٓ اِلَيَّ رَبِّيْؕ اِنَّهٗ سَمِيْعٌ قَرِيْبٌ
ayahs.translation: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul in dalaltu fa'innamaa adillu 'alaa nafsee wa'inihtadaytu fabimaa yoohee ilayya rabbee innahoo samee'un qareeb
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If I err, I err only to my own loss; but if I am guided, it is by what my Lord inspires me. He is Hearing and Near.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذْ فَزِعُوْا فَلَا فَوْتَ وَاُخِذُوْا مِنْ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيْبٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And if you could see[1238] when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw taraa idh fazi'oo falaa fawta wa'ukhidhoo mim makaanin qareeb

footnotes.1238: i.e., have a glimpse of the Hereafter.

ayahs.translationClear: If you could only see when they are terrified, and there is no escape, and they are seized from a nearby place.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّقَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۚ وَاَنّٰي لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking[1239] [of faith] from a place far away?[1240]
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo aamannaa bihee wa'annaa lahumut-tanaawushu mim makaanim ba'eed

footnotes.1239: Literally, "taking of something within easy reach," in other words, "How can they expect to obtain faith at this point?"
footnotes.1240: i.e., their former life on earth, wherein they had every opportunity but which is now gone, never to return.

ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “We have believed in it.” But how can they attain it from a distant place?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ‌ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّقَدْ كَفَرُوْا بِهٖ مِنْ قَبْلُۚ وَيَقْذِفُوْنَ بِالْغَيْبِ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ
ayahs.translation: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault[1241] the unseen from a place far away.[1242]
ayahs.transliteration: Waqad kafaroo bihee min qablu wayaqdhifoona bil-ghaybi mim makaanim ba'eed

footnotes.1242: i.e., a position far from truth.

ayahs.translationClear: They have rejected it in the past, and made allegations from a far-off place.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَحِيْلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُوْنَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِاَشْيَاعِهِمْ مِّنْ قَبْلُؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا فِيْ شَكٍّ مُّرِيْبٍ ࣖ

words.translation: And a barrier will be placed

ayahs.translation: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire,[1243] as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
ayahs.transliteration: Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi'ashyaa'ihim min qablu innahum kaanoo fee shakkim mureeb

footnotes.1243: Meaning the attainment of faith and its benefits or entrance into Paradise.

ayahs.translationClear: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done formerly with their counterparts. They were in disturbing doubt.
